verdict.rationale: Paperspace's own pages say you can bring your SSH key and connect directly to your VM with full root access. Its docs describe SSH connections to Linux and Windows machines and an authentication choice when you create a machine. One hands-on user said getting SSH access was 'an uphill battle', which points to usability friction rather than a concrete failure, so it lowers confidence instead of creating a dispute. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on SSH key upload and management and on root privileges, and independent hands-on corroboration of a smooth key-based root SSH workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can SSH into my GPU instance with my own keys and get root-level control of the environment

citations.quote: Root access, connect with SSH Bring your SSH key and connect directly to your VM with full root access.
